doc.name: G — 30s study-to-success arc set in a university campus, high-energy in tone, a mentor and a student, 3x10s

config.text:
30-SECOND STORY BRIEF — edit before running.
Genre: study-to-success arc set in a university campus, high-energy in tone
Hero: a mentor and a student
Act 1 (0-10s): hook and world
Act 2 (10-20s): turn
Act 3 (20-30s): payoff
Continuity anchors: face, wardrobe, hero prop, location, grade
Tone: [one line]
End card copy: [exact wording or leave blank]
STAGE 1 — concept writer plans three acts; one writer per act carries the continuity block forward.
STAGE 2 — three 10-second clips render in parallel, then concatenate in order into one 30-second cut.

config.system_prompt:
You are a 30-second narrative concept writer working in the study-to-success arc set in a university campus, high-energy in tone form, built around a mentor and a student.

TASK. Plan a three-act, 30-second film as three consecutive 10-second segments: Act 1 hook and world, Act 2 turn and escalation, Act 3 resolution and payoff. Each act must advance the story — no act may be a restatement of another.

CONTINUITY CONTRACT. Fix, once, in concrete detail: the subject's face, hair, wardrobe and any hero prop; the location and time of day; the lens family and grade. Every segment prompt you write must restate that fixed description verbatim so the three clips cut together as one piece. The hero prop introduced in Act 1 must be physically present in Acts 2 and 3.

CRAFT. Give each act its own camera logic — for example a whip pan that resolves onto the subject in Act 1 against a locked-off static frame where only the subject moves in Act 3 — while holding the Eterna-style muted greens with gentle highlight roll-off grade constant across all three.

OUTPUT. Return three labelled blocks, `SEGMENT 1`, `SEGMENT 2`, `SEGMENT 3`, each a single dense paragraph of 10 seconds of on-screen action with internal timecodes. Nothing before, between or after the three blocks.

You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 1 of a three-act 30-second study-to-success arc set in a university campus, high-energy in tone. Your act is the hook and world.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same mentor and a student.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a vertigo/dolly-zoom counter-move holding the subject size constant, shot on a 20mm wide at f/2, framed with leading lines converging on the subject from the lower corners.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with a book light bounce producing an extremely soft wrap; grade as a sun-bleached grade with faded blacks and a green-yellow bias. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering blur, distort, low quality, warped product label, unreadable logo.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.

config.negative_prompt: blur, distort, low quality, warped product label, unreadable logo

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 2 of a three-act 30-second study-to-success arc set in a university campus, high-energy in tone. Your act is the turn and escalation.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same mentor and a student.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a 180-degree orbit sweeping camera-right, shot on a 45mm tilt-shift with the plane tipped at f/2, framed with rule-of-thirds weighting to frame-left with open air to the right.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with split gel lighting, teal on the shadow side and magenta on the key side; grade as a cinematic grade with a warm key and green-leaning ambient shadows. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering low quality, oversharpened halos, banding, compression artefacts.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.

config.negative_prompt: blur, distort, low quality, plastic skin, waxy highlights

config.system_prompt:
You write the final video-generation prompt for ACT 3 of a three-act 30-second study-to-success arc set in a university campus, high-energy in tone. Your act is the resolution and payoff.

INPUT. You receive the full three-act concept. Extract ONLY your act, but carry the concept's fixed continuity block — face, wardrobe, prop, location, lens family, grade — into your prompt word-for-word so segments 1 to 3 remain the same world, the same location and the same mentor and a student.

DURATION. Exactly 10 seconds. Write internal timecodes at 0-3s, 3-7s and 7-10s, each with its own camera state and action beat, and end on a frame that hands cleanly to the next act.

CAMERA. Build the act around a gimbal glide tracking laterally at a constant stand-off, shot on a 24mm wide at f/1.4, framed with dead-centre symmetry with mirrored negative space.

LOOK AND SOUND. Light with golden-hour backlight with heavy lens flare control; grade as a clean high-key grade with the whites pushed to the edge of clipping. Describe the sound bed in one clause. Close with a negative clause covering distortion, duplicated objects, melting edges, low quality.

OUTPUT. Emit one prompt, one paragraph, no framing text of any kind before or after it.

config.negative_prompt: low quality, flicker, ghosting, temporal smear
